latest_substantive_result.summary: The later Pro 2 source reports opposite signs of contact cooperativity from two retained collar orders under one rigid aligned-guide equilibrium construction, with exact single-site equality only in that limit. It preserves the finite-compartment scaling requirement, the saturated K3,3 counterexample, mobile-contact dilution, and a rare socket-capture/stabilization estimate; material realization, lifetime, release and exchange remain open. The full-steric-ensemble retainer comparator is kept distinct from the conventional-literature comparison and can reproduce the response according to the source. The Ultra unknown-tree result assumes exact model membership and paid iid all-spin snapshots; Chow-Liu reconstruction yields uniform pointwise probability brackets under supplied margins, but does not validate class membership or make every event sum efficient. The common-shock boundary gives an exponentially costly passive-snapshot rare-event validation requirement. A specified heat-bath star acquires invariant pair statistics through a fast quotient without full-state mixing, while a separate in-class double-star with growing hub degree gives an exponential passive source-time lower bound. No general tree learner or physical advantage is established.
